title: Zesty Velvety Middle Eastern Apricot Tagine
description: A light and citrusy Middle Eastern dish featuring apricot jam and cooked to perfection with binchotan charcoal, this tagine is a flavorful and velvety delight. It is a perfect dish for those looking for a taste of the exotic without heavy spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat on a binchotan charcoal grill or a stovetop.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the apricot jam and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs or toasted almonds if desired.
